class E {
  private static final Map<String, Entry> SESSIONS = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Entry>();
  void started() {
    Clock.schedulePeriodically(this, BRelTime.makeMinutes(1), sweep, null);
  }
  void login(String id) {
    SESSIONS.put(id, new Entry());
  }
  void logout(String id) {
    if (sweep(id)) {
      SESSIONS.remove(id);
    }
  }
  boolean sweep(String id) {
    return true;
  }
}
